notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
-Cultists Rituals!
There are 4 cultists ritual sites.
Destroy ALL the pillars before 13 days are up or you suffer a permanent curse for each.
A completed pillar ritual takes away 2 GP every 50% chance daily permanent basis!
It also removes your ability to travel to that location by map. You'll need other methods.
Cultist Curse has 50% chance to adds 1 additional fatigue or incase of full fatigue: -4% health.
You daily 50% chance lose 100 achievement points per completed pillar too!
Yes these effects are stacking!
As a reward stopping a cultist site you gain 8 GP and 2 PP.
-Your winning scores will reflect and factor how many rituals you stopped!

-Change/New: About Me section added to Allies talk menu.
-Change: Allies when told to Go Home, now go to the exact place you first met them.
-New: Puzzle Boxes! Solving one gives you 1 PP.
Until you've solved atleast 5 puzzle boxes, you may lose 3 PP at 33% chance per day.
Additionally you will lose some Money and XP points.
To regain lost money/xp you should solve an unsolved puzzlebox. 
However you only get 1/2 of what you lost back!
Failed attempts to solve a particular puzzlebox has directs adverse effect on your character and warps you to a random
location.

-Change/New: The wall posters / memes, now give you XP and achievement points!
(Once per.)

notes.title: Patch 1.03. - Now in maintenance mode!
notes.content:
I've bumped the build version to 1.03.

The game is now in permanent maintenance mode.

Redaxium has been a fully released game since December 27th 2021.

New content too often breaks something especially saved games.
1.02 did this multiple times and i'm completely out of patience now.

The only cure is to stop adding new content. Thus maintenance mode.

I'll fix bugs once in a LONG WHILE, but i'm looking forward to Redaxium 2.
You should as well.

The silver lining is there's two bosses now, and an official end game!
I even tweaked the UI this past week. Although i'm sure it still has issues.

Take care.

notes.title: Patch 1.02

God must be appeased. To do this you must make sacrifices at God Shrines.
This is in blood (health) and survival stats.
If you do not earn enough God Points before 6 days is up,
God will take vengeance on you.
There are 4 God Shrines in the game.
-New: Time / Space Ruptures.
Takes 1 MP to try to close them.
Failure to close will randomly temporarily hide them for 1 to 2 days.
You will gain anxiety at random for attempting to close one.
Successfully closing one gives you PP!
With 100 PP, you win the game!
If you win the game, God will leave you alone.
There are 10 Time/Space Ruptures in the game.
-Change: Achievement points gained per day lowered.
(reminder: character's made with respawn mode enabled do not get this benefit)
-Note: You will likely have to re-roll your character or start a new one.

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Patch 1.0 is here! 

-Fix: Save games were freezing camera/controls for those who skipped tutorial.
-Fix: Regression introduced caused combat to freeze upon loading a saved game.
-New: Elemental and Defense skills now require MP. You use up MP by using the skill.
-New: To regenerate MP find a Ulagakawwewzi shrine pillar.
You'll need Bodyparts and the specific material type its refill ritual requires.
-Change: The way to know what skills you own is to use the Skillbar menu.
Not the Skilltree menu anymore.
-Change: Stripped complexity of Skilltree menu.
Just hover mouse over skill to know a skill's details before learning it.
-Change: Skillbar cannot be opened from the Skilltree menu,
if your have unused skillpoints.
However opening Skilltree from Skillbar is still allowed.
-Change: When placing your tent if you move on the World Map,
it will no longer likely be placed in the same encounter you were just at.
Also special encounters such as the Inn or Waterhole can no longer have tent placed at.
Instead another place will be chosen.
-Fix: Missing reference exception(s) caused by time callbacks.
-Change: Stack limit for materials is now set to 30.
-Change: Stack limit for food (crops mostly) is now set to 10.
-Change: Your first use of Mining, Digging, Fishing, and Farm veins
now guarantees success.
-New: Sound for gamble.
-Note: I'd recommend re-rolling your characters or starting a new game.

No new quests yet.

notes.title: Patch 0.81
notes.content:
-Change: Added a Bodypart Collector to Blastquack.
They are hidden in some hills.
They give 2 candies for 1 Bodypart.
-Change: Added two new containers to the world with guaranteed bodyparts to be in them.
Clue: doctor.
-Important: Bodyparts always have a chance to drop from npcs you kill.
-Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch 0.80
notes.content:
-Change: Decorated Enlightened Temple Way for Halloween.
There's also some candy to find there!
-New: Added Sphere Hunter. Gives quests to hunt golden spheres.
The hunter is at Temple Way.
Completing one of the quests adds to your MiscQuests score.
These quests don't save with your game, so you should be ready to complete them if you start one.
-Fixed: A bunch of regressions that were interrupting the save/load process.

If for some reason candy does not appear don't worry.  
Tomorrow another update is planned to allow more ways to get candy.

notes.title: Patch 0.79
notes.content:

hint: you can take a transporter to Wildpoint from there to meet some special NPCs.

In other news:

notes.content:

note: You must use this to make skills you learn available in combat.

-Change: Adjusted startup screen music.

notes.content:

Hopefully this eases the pain of re-rolling even more.

notes.title: Patch 0.73
notes.content:
-Change/Fix: Water item now has thirst cure.

-Change: DTE renamed to E.D. Expiration Date. Meaning when item expires it disappears.

-New: Added a new creature. Stempod.

notes.title: Patch 0.72
notes.content:

Go to portraits\custom (windows OS) folder or portaits/custom (linux OS) folder and read the readme.txt

It should persist if you save.

-Repairman now sells C-Picks.

-Removed devjournal. Only accessible in hidden cheat mode now.
-Removed Fuel item and C-picks from container ontop of the People's Nexus.
(note: CarMechanic  still sells fuel ups.)

You may want to re-roll your character(s).

notes.title: Patch 0.71
notes.content:
-Change: Melee skills now count under physical affinity.
-New/Change: Partial affinities grant 10% more damage for associated element type. Full affinities grant 20% more damage for associated
element type.
-Change: Affinities are no longer resettable once chosen and entered game.
-Change: Reinstated picking skills at character creation screen.
(It still need work presentation-wise)

-Change: Moved "Menus" button to the main panel.

-New: You can set a custom portrait for your character.

(note: not skillbooks!)

--A perishable. Random perishable.

(Only for those characters not created with respawning enabled.)

notes.content:
-Added library to Lagorigana. Findable in Shadowtown.

They sell and buy Materials and Artifacts at inflated prices.

Don't forget if you experience issues you can re-roll a character.

notes.title: Patch 0.62
notes.content:
-Fixed: Discovered a critical issue in save renumbering code. 
-Change: Melee skill proficiency gets kept across re-roll. I figure this is fair since Melee skills are the weakest.
-New/Change: Characters' who pick the Explorer specialty get one random town/location pre-discovered. 
-New: Hobbyist. If you didn't pick a specialty in the beginning of the game, you can now do so at a later time.
Find the Hobbyist at Field Of Remorse.
-New: Merc Trainer. Will train your allies level up to within 5 of your own.
You can also the Trainer to train you but its pretty costly. It results in one spendable stat point.
Find the Merc Trainer at Field Of Remorse.

notes.title: Patch 0.61
notes.content:
-Broke save compat again. This should be the last time for a while.
-For versions update hereon, you can attempt to re-roll your character.
(Only available if game version is a mismatch for your save version.)
This will not work for 0.60 files. Too much changed.
-You can no longer have multiple saves with the same title.
-Fixed issue where hardcore mode was always reported as true when view save info in loading screen.
-Fixed issue where could attempt to load a deleted file.
-Change: if a save file turns up missing the save list will renumber itself.

More about re-roll:
You keep your name, age, specialty, experience, level, money, skillpoints, and statpoints.
You DON'T keep things like equipment or quest progress.

notes.title: Patch 0.60
notes.content:
-There are now skyboxes for multiple times of day not just day/night.
Regardless all skyboxes have had their texture tweaked.
-Added another Renewer between the People's Nexus and Lagorigana Cacophony. 
(Nearish to Friendzone Park.)
-Since Melee skills are pretty weak, i've decided their proficiency shall increase from combat use as well.
Guaranteed 1 point gain per use. To boost weapon skills you still must use a book.
-New/Experimental: After calling forward your ally (outside of battle), you may give them order to
attack a nearby target.
-New: Doctor's Field Pak. Purchaseable from doctors for 1000 jipjips.
Use to heal limbs.
-Fixed a potential nullref bug when a non-human aggroes someone.

notes.title: Patch 0.59
notes.content:
-You can use the Interaction menu (right click), and pick Chat option to see what an NPC thinks.
(The text won't fade or change on you.)
-Added a few more overhead speech lines.
-You can now drag & drop between equipped slots in inventory.
-Added button to cycle hand while in inventory.

notes.title: Patch 0.58
notes.content:
Change:
Defense proficiency effects (affects effectiveness of your defense skills):
Boosts defense skill's duration by 10% of your proficiency.
Boosts defense skill's additional defense by 10% of your proficiency.

This is only factored during battle.

Change:
Attack proficiency effects (affects effectiveness of your attack skills):
Boost attack skill's damage by 1/2 of your proficiency.

This is only factored during battle.

Change:
Proficiency gain rate is now 50% chance to increase by 1 for every hit.

note: your Hit chance is affected by proficiency.

note: For attacks, proficiency increase is also faster if your affinity matches the skill choice.
Also more so if you're level was lower than that of your target.


In summary:
Melee, Weapon, Defense skills are only increased from skill books.
Attack skills increases from use of the attack or skill books.
Roleplaying skills like Analyze/Steal, are WIP when it comes to increasing proficiency.

NPCs can level up from winning battles and increase their proficiency too from attacking. 
Don't be too careless, especially if you have respawning enabled for your player.

notes.title: Patch 0.57
notes.content:
-Broke saves again when improving support for Melee/Weapon skill boosting. 
(I guess it should be my next priority to add better support for save upgrades.)

-Fixed a text duplication bug. Showing level requirement twice.

-Change: Investing in Defense and Attack skills that require more AP than you have,
will result in a warning.

-Reduced number of attack skills that can be taken for new characters.

-Defense skills can now be taken immediately for new characters.


Change:
-Added check to prevent player wasting a skill book if they had no skills it could apply to.

New/Change:
-Melee and Weapon skills now can actually be boosted!

--Weapon Proficiency effects (affects weapons generally in TBC):
--Weapon Hit Chance Boost = WeaponProf / 20;
--Weapon Damage Boost = WeaponProf / 2;

--Melee Proficiency effects (affects melee attacks generall in TBC):
--Melee Hit Chance Boost = MeleeProf / 20;
--Melee Damage Boost = MeleeProf / 2;
Note: Weapon and Melee skill proficiencies only go up via books.

notes.title: Patch 0.56
notes.content:

--Generic Loop. (in addition to the existing one)
--Dungeon.
--Battle / Combat.
-New night sky. (shows when around midnight, was easier to do than I thought.)
--also 2 new tracks. one for morning (5 to 6am), and one for night.

notes.title: Patch 0.51
notes.content:

-Your character will no longer rotate if you put your mouse at edge of screen while 
over the main panel.
-Your character will no longer snap to where you click if your mouse is over the main panel.

-Broke save compatibility. You'll need new saves. (That means to start over)
-Also: I discovered I accidentally left in a mandatory save incompatibility routine! This would mean the past patches broke your saves each time. This has been deprecated, and now only prints a warning.
-Stairs now properly respond to right-click as a method to use them.
-Beds can now be used by right-click.
-The mass-aggro toward player still baffles me.

notes.title: Patch 0.50
notes.content:
-Media items like books, skillbooks, picture, and picturebook
no longer will have a random level requirement.
-New terminology tab in Help menu.
-Fixed potential bug where player could rotate when viewing an info item.
-Weapon used in attack in TBC is now outputted to activity log for player.
-When player is attacking in TBC the bodypart targeted in the attack is now outputted to the activity log.
-Attempted a fix of weird mass aggro. I'm not sure if I solved it.
I'm not positive but there may be some kind of enemy of my enemy is my friend situation being triggered.

-Inventory Drag & Drop should work a bit more intuitively now.
